steps.content: [Program Logo Intro]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: The juiciest election buzz, the freshest campaign scoops, and the most outlandish candidate tales! From breaking headlines to deep dives, we're here to sift through the truth and the tall tales! Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the special edition of Truth or Troll—the <color=#fb9259>[Election Focus]</color>!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Last night, #WestDistrictExplosion topped DisPhantom's trending list in the early hours. How did an ordinary explosion capture the spotlight in the dead of night? What secrets lurk behind the smoke? Was it a mere mishap, or a darker scheme at play?

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Coming up next, we will be talking to <color=#fb9259>Pine</color>, the commentator of the popular independent channel <color=#fb9259>[The Hedgehog's Eye]</color>, ready to delve into the enigma surrounding this peculiar event with us.
[Standard Program Transition]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Greetings, Miss Pine! Great to have you here on [Election Focus]. What's your take on the West District explosion? Do you suspect this could be a political hit job in the making?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: A political hit job? An explosion without casualties hardly meets the assassination criteria. DisCity has witnessed its fair share of genuine hits—so why the fuss over this one?

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Are you implying... that some media channels are purposefully hyping up this event for drama's sake?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: December's almost there, and with the election coming up, it's no surprise to see all sorts of dubious characters crawling out of the woodwork.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Absolutely, this upcoming month is known for its <color=#fb9259>December Surprises</color>, where unexpected bombshells hit the headlines. Could this explosion be setting the stage for this year's shocking revelations?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: This is hardly grand enough to kick off the show. It's just the Eastside bigwigs feeling threatened by the West District's growing clout, using petty tricks to smear Syndicate's name.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: First, they use the explosion to grab everyone's attention, then the mainstream media jumps in, pushing their narrative: poor public security in the West District, Syndicans dissatisfied with policies, resistance against Eastside capital, blah blah blah...

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: That's all they know—the same old playbook.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: What a shocking revelation! So... who exactly are the puppet masters pulling the strings behind all this?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: The Prime Minister, aka our distinguished Speaker of DisCity <color=#fb9259>Stewart</color> is definitely one of them. After all, he's been trying so hard to keep the West District in shambles—just imagine the humiliation for him if the district really were to thrive.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: With such a hot story, not a peep from him? Guilty conscience, if you ask me.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Is Stewart the only player in this game? The other two candidates both made public appearances today, promising thorough investigations. Surely they're not involved in this.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Hah, who's to say? One's a sly old ****, the other a total megalomaniac. What a show, what a spectacle! I'm betting all three candidates go down in flames. You care to join in?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: We've still got the whole of December—just wait for the grand show, guys.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: We'll definitely be keeping an eye out for that. Thank you, Miss Pine, for your fascinating insights today. Now, let's dive into some other juicy tidbits.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: An anonymous tycoon throws their support behind Max King with a billion DisCoins poured into Max King's campaign!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Prime Minister Stewart's secret "smurf" has been exposed, his private life shockingly blurring his public face.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Thieves justify repeated break-ins at the Eastside Public Security Bureau, claiming it to be a protest against escalating crime rates.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Online betting no longer seems enough as Eastside residents take their political rivalry to the streets.
